dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: I haven't seen an unfamiliar face in the village for quite sometime. Such energy and liveliness! Ah, it really is great to be young...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Are you looking for me? Have you run into any difficulties?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about yourself, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: My name is Konda Densuke, and I'm the village head here. I welcome you on behalf of everyone here.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Though we are a small village, our history runs even further than Ritou Harbor. A long, long, long time ago, the Almighty Shogun granted my ancestors this land.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: From that moment onward, this village was named Konda Village and has been managed by my family ever since.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What can you tell me about Konda Village?

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: You see those Lavender Melons in the fields? That's our proud local specialty.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Is it good? Oh my, is it delicious! It is filled with useful materials from top to bottom. Merchants and dyehouses love these melons. Not only can you cook with it, the flowers can also be used to make natural and durable dye. It can even act as pest repellent!

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Oh, our village used to be so lively. Merchants looking for dye, adventurers heading to Inazuma from Ritou, outlanders touring the land... This place used be filled with people from everywhere, and I used to show them around and give them directions.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Too bad all that's in the past now. Ever since the Sakoku Decree came into force, it became difficult for outlanders to make their way here. Merchandise became hard to sell and dyehouses no longer needed that much dye. As a result, the fields have all gone to waste...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: What a shame. This historical village and its fertile land... it's all gone to waste! *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about the treasure at the bottom of the well...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: At first, it was the doing of those drunken teenagers.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: But no one expected that their memories of the incident would suddenly disappear once they sobered up. The investigators couldn't find any signs of them lying and hastily closed the case.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Afterwards, I said what needed to be said, and yelled at whoever needed yelling at. I believe they're aware of the severity of their mistake.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: *sigh* However... there are some things that should be kept within the village... It's not that it would embarrass me, it's just that with the village being in this state, and with me growing old and useless...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: I can't let the remaining seniors and youngsters take the blame for covering something up. I can't let them shoulder that bad name...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Off you go, then. Work hard while you're still young!

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Say, now that the Sakoku Decree has been abolished, do you think there's any chance that we can revive our village's fortunes by returning to our old industry?
